pages.title: Photonic Logic Wafer
pages.text: A wafer engraved with waveguides instead of wires, so its logic runs on light. Signals cross without interfering and switch in femtoseconds. Held to the light, the engravings scatter a faint rainbow across my palm.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Quantum Lithographer, I exposed a Cherenkov Wafer through Quantum-Dot Photoresist. The dots blocked light precisely where I needed waveguides, and the pattern etched itself into the wafer.
Made in $(item)Quantum Lithographer$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Precision Lithography.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Coherent Wiring Harness, Empirical Notes II, Photonic Die, Warm Helium.
